# AI Profile Photo Maker
> Generate studio-quality AI headshots from selfies in minutes.

## What We Do
AI Profile Photo Maker transforms 10-20 casual selfie photos into professional headshots using AI. Upload your photos (front-facing + slight angles), choose a style, and get studio-quality results — no photographer needed.

## Who It's For
- Job seekers needing LinkedIn/resume headshots
- Professionals wanting corporate headshots
- Realtors, lawyers, doctors needing industry-specific portraits
- Anyone wanting better dating profile or social media photos

## How It Works
1. Upload 10-20 photos (front-facing, good lighting, slight angle variety)
2. AI trains a custom model on your features
3. Choose from professional styles (corporate, casual, creative, etc.)
4. Download high-resolution headshots

## Pricing
- Free tier available (limited styles)
- Starter: affordable entry plan
- Pro: full style library + priority generation
- See full pricing: https://aiprofilephotomaker.com/pricing
